headline: MAJOR ANDRÉ TAKEN WITH PAPERS OF WEST POINT
dispatch: TARRYTOWN, Sept. 24. Three New York militiamen yesterday stopped a stranger riding southward and found military papers concealed in his stockings. The prisoner, identifying himself as Major John André of the British army, was sent under guard to the Continental command; the documents bear General Arnold's hand.
answer: Patriots capture John André, exposing Arnold's plot, 1780
